title: Oath and Crown
author: J. M. Joubert
blurb: Kestrel Oyelaran, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
